model: Markers outside a 5% pad around the viewport were faded out. A short pan crossed that pad, so edge markers spent 300ms going transparent and then came back. The pad is now 25% on each side, so a pan up to a quarter of the viewport keeps those markers opaque.

noise.rule: Area is (1 + 2*pad)^2. 1.21 is 1.1^2 and 2.25 is 1.5^2. The 10% fade strip is max(0, 0.10 - pad). Marker count scales with area only when restaurants are spread evenly. Not a sampled pan.
